principles: Exactly one declared next transition from every nonterminal state.
Each transition consumes exactly one self-contained stage receipt.
Receipts contain direct check results only; receipts may not depend on or cite other receipts, policy documents, runbooks, or postmortems.
No recursive evaluation, rule chaining, document precedence, or cross-stage boolean graph.
Unknown or missing checks fail closed.
Human approvals are explicit fields on the transition receipt.
Exact source identity may be a Git commit or a content-addressed source tree/archive; Git metadata is not mandatory if stronger content identity is proven.

execution_system.purpose: Make the existing lifecycle model execute linearly with evidence reuse, selective invalidation, failure isolation, and safe parallelism; this is part of the primary control model, not a new authority layer.

evidence_inheritance.rule: A passed check remains valid for the exact subject it proves until an explicit invalidator changes.
evidence_inheritance.unknown_impact: Conservatively broaden verification only when impact cannot be established; do not automatically reopen unrelated closed gates.
evidence_inheritance.host_failure_rule: A host/test-harness failure does not invalidate firmware/runtime evidence unless device identity, restart continuity, renderer restore, AUX health, or another actual device gate is unknown or failed.
evidence_inheritance.no_repeat_rule: Do not rerun a passed check merely because a new transaction, chat, sequence number, or worker begins.

HOST_HARNESS.default_action: repair/replay host path against fixtures; preserve device installation when exact identity/health/restore evidence remains valid

DEVICE_RUNTIME.default_action: localize device/runtime defect; recover only when required by health/safety

RELEASE_DEPLOYMENT.default_action: repair release/deployment mechanism without reopening unrelated product/runtime evidence

PHYSICAL_HARDWARE.default_action: repair/retest affected physical subsystem and its direct integration only

AESTHETIC_PRODUCT.default_action: iterate affected feature without reopening unrelated technical gates

TELEMETRY_INSTRUMENTATION.default_action: make the smallest measurement-only change needed to observe the required range; preserve renderer/root-cause/performance evidence; prove bounded instrumentation delta offline, then remeasure observer effect once on the changed artifact

required_verification: full runtime telemetry sweep and soak

parallelism.rule: Exactly one live-device mutation lane at a time. Dependency-satisfied host/offline/staging lanes run concurrently when they cannot alter the live candidate or its evidence.

activation.foundation_soak: When the Foundation soak is cleanly running, the live worker must emit PARALLEL_LANES_READY and checkpoint authority. The coordinator then launches one separate worker context per offline-safe core lane. The live worker is not expected or allowed to fabricate parallelism inside one chat.
activation.phase2: At PHASE2_INTEGRATING and RELEASE_CANDIDATE, all four core lanes must be tracked as ACTIVE, DONE, or BLOCKED_WITH_EXACT_DEPENDENCY.

parallelism.anti_abandonment: A ready lane may be removed, serialized, or deferred only for an explicit dependency or user scope change; chat turnover, worker turnover, sequence changes, or convenience are not valid reasons.
sequencing: Integration waits for lane outputs; ready lanes do not wait for integration.
A worker may combine implementation internally only if each lane remains independently tracked.

orchestration.capability_boundary: A worker chat cannot create additional chats/workers. Parallel worker creation is an external coordinator/user action, not a responsibility of the live Foundation worker.
live_worker_role: continue the one live-device mutation lane
when the Foundation soak is cleanly running, checkpoint current authority and emit PARALLEL_LANES_READY
do not serialize the four core implementation lanes inside the live worker merely because it cannot spawn them
later integrate outputs after their separate workers return
coordinator_role: launch one separate worker context per core lane when PARALLEL_LANES_READY is emitted
bind every lane worker to current HBNF_CONTROL_MODEL/HBNF_CONTROL_STATE and its lane contract
prevent overlapping file ownership or live-device mutation
record each launched worker/context in lane_execution
orchestration.failure_ownership: Failure to spawn parallel workers is an orchestration/coordinator failure, never a failure of a worker that lacks spawn capability.

execution_system.priority_rule: Critical-path work first; use unavoidable wait/soak time for ready parallel work; never create event-only throwaway architecture when the same work can advance final Cart 2.0.

authority_contract.product_scope: Canonical Cart 2.0 scope/acceptance authority is reconciled into the T3 phase2_scope_lock receipt; product documents do not independently mutate lifecycle state.
authority_contract.diagnostic_memory: config/HBNF_SOLVED_PROBLEMS.json is reusable diagnostic memory and regression routing, not lifecycle authority.
authority_contract.conflict_rule: If reference/history disagrees with current operational model/state, it cannot block or redirect execution. Reconcile any still-valid requirement into the primary model/state once; do not add another authority layer.
authority_contract.generated_status_rule: Current status, next action, invalidation impact, and parallel-lane compliance must be derived from the primary model/state rather than restated as new authority documents.

prelive_offline_first.rule: Before a live-device mutation, eliminate every reasonably testable host/orchestration failure offline using captured fixtures, exact artifacts, and dry-run/replay paths.
prelive_offline_first.live_hardware_role: Use live hardware only for evidence that cannot be obtained offline. Host/tooling defects discovered live become regression fixtures before another equivalent live attempt.
prelive_offline_first.no_sequence_for_host_only_rule: A host-only defect does not justify a new firmware sequence or reinstall when exact candidate identity, health, restart continuity, renderer restore, and required AUX health remain proven.

learning_loop.rule: Every newly proven recurring failure class must be converted into a solved-problem record plus an automated regression fixture/test when technically practical.
learning_loop.recurrence_trigger: A second occurrence of the same process/tooling failure class blocks another equivalent live attempt until a regression guard exists.
learning_loop.optimization_target: Drive live attempts wasted by host/process defects toward zero; do not optimize by weakening device/runtime safety gates.
learning_loop.no_rediscovery: Solved issues are not reinvestigated unless their explicit do_not_rediscover_unless condition is met.

metrics.tracking_scope: From execution-system consolidation forward; historical attempts remain evidence but are not retroactively guessed into counters.
metrics.update_rule: Record a classified failure event when a live attempt closes. Use counters to expose recurring process waste, not as a release gate or performance target that could incentivize hiding failures.

release_scope.rule: Deferred items remain Cart 2.0 expansion scope but do not block the core ACCEPTED transition unless the user explicitly moves them back onto the critical path.
hard_go_no_go: authoritative Skins scoring works end-to-end on intended owner device
owner can reliably control the cart/system with confirmed state and no Mac/Terminal during normal round use
development_priority: Vibe/audio quality and nuanced music reactivity
owner Mission Control/PWA refinement beyond the hard operational gate
release_scope.operating_standard: Field use must be appliance-like: start, score/control when intentionally needed, otherwise ignore the technology while playing/hosting.

observability.purpose: Provide externally readable progress without turning progress reporting into operational authority.
worker_rules: Update immediately on meaningful stage transitions.
If no stage transition occurs, send a lightweight heartbeat about every 15 minutes only when doing so will not interrupt a build, sweep, soak, OTA, recovery, or other critical blocking operation.
Before any operation expected to block longer than 15 minutes, write one heartbeat first; update immediately when it returns.
Never interrupt or restart substantive work merely to satisfy heartbeat cadence.
Do not repeat unchanged detail; update only current action, last completed, next checkpoint, blocker, mutation state, branch/head, timestamps, and concise notes.
Report the concrete action actually underway, not generic labels such as researching, working, or running commands.
Do not use the status sheet to authorize mutation, change lifecycle state, invalidate evidence, or override control model/state.
observability.read_rule: Coordinator may read this sheet at any time to report actual worker progress without waiting for a worker-chat return.
observability.stale_rule: A stale heartbeat is an observability warning only. It does not fail Foundation, trigger rollback, authorize intervention, or require interrupting a critical operation.

user_status_summary_contract.purpose: Make status/update/outlook replies communicate broad project position before low-level execution detail.
required_order: OVERALL_CART2_POSITION: current lifecycle stage, what major stages are complete, and what major stages remain.
CURRENT_PROCESS_POSITION: what the active process is for, how far through it is in broad gate terms, and how it moves Cart 2.0 forward.
OUTLOOK: realistic best-case/likely remaining path, biggest uncertainty, and whether user action is needed.
RECENT_DELTA: only the few technical details that materially changed the broad outlook.
progress_measurement: Use lifecycle transitions and major acceptance gates as the primary progress units.
Do not use commits, test counts, sequence numbers, or debugging activity as proxies for project progress.
When a sub-gate has a natural count (for example 22/28 kernels), it may be shown as supporting context but must not be confused with completion of the containing lifecycle stage.
Avoid false-precision percentages for overall Cart 2.0; use broad terms such as early/mid/late stage unless the denominator is authoritative.
response_style: Lead with broad progress and remaining work.
Keep implementation detail subordinate unless it changes risk/outlook.
Explicitly distinguish CURRENT PROCESS completion from OVERALL CART 2.0 completion.
If the user asks only 'status' or 'update', do not require a follow-up to learn the overall outlook.
user_status_summary_contract.anti_complexity: This is a reporting-format rule inside the existing observability section. It must not create a separate lifecycle, gate, policy file, worker requirement, or execution dependency.
